edits.old: Then the case returns to the route decision and the rule gap is logged
edits.new:
Then the case returns to the route decision and the rule gap is logged

  Scenario: AC17 The business rules hold in the build (BR1 to BR10)
    Given the build, the grants, the contract, the workflow inputs and the outbox of rwb_valuation are checked
    When the guardrail test runs
    Then every rule BR1 to BR10 of section 8 holds
    Then any breach fails the build and nothing is released

  Scenario: AC18 A call has no credential, no right or an unknown resource (X2)
    Given a call to a provided operation has no valid credential, its role does not hold the right, or it names a case or assessment that is not found
    When the operation is called
    Then the system answers 401 with no valid credential, 403 as in AC3 for a role without the right, and 404 when the resource is not found
    Then no read, no agent call and no write is made

  Scenario: AC19 A write is replayed with the same key (R-UNI-40)
    Given a write of the operations is submitted again with the same Idempotency-Key
    When the replay arrives
    Then the stored response is returned with no second agent call, no second record and no second write
    Then the replay is counted

  Scenario: AC20 An activity is retried or times out (X9)
    Given an activity of RouteDecisionWorkflow fails or does not complete within its timeout
    When the workflow retries the activity
    Then the retry follows the retry policy of the workflow and writes nothing before the record
    Then a timed-out activity is not recorded as a recommendation

  Scenario: AC21 A consumed call fails (X9)
    Given a consumed call to rwb-source-data, rwb-case or rwb-decision fails or does not answer
    When the step reads from it
    Then nothing is written and the caller sees 503 with the platform envelope
    Then a failed call to rwb-agent follows AC5 and is not treated here

  Scenario: AC22 A status change is not allowed (X7)
    Given a status change that the model does not allow is requested
    When the step applies it
    Then the change is refused, nothing is written and the state is reported to the parent
